title: Partnership basis adjustments: the section 754 election
rule: A section 754 election adjusts partnership property basis on every transfer of an interest and every distribution in that year and later years. Without one, the adjustments still apply on a transfer when the partnership has a substantial built-in loss and on a distribution with a substantial basis reduction. On a sale, exchange or partner's death, section 743(b) adjusts basis, for the transferee alone, by the gap between its basis in the interest (at death, generally fair market value under section 1014) and its share of partnership basis. Section 734(b) adjusts for distributions. The partnership elects with its timely return; revocation needs IRS approval, refused if mainly to avoid step-downs.
changeWatch: Amendments to sections 754, 743 or 734, including the substantial built-in loss and substantial basis reduction thresholds, or to the election and revocation procedure in 26 CFR 1.754-1.
